title: Cecropin D-derived synthetic peptides in the fight against Candida albicans cell filamentation and biofilm formation.
summary: Worker-4/6 re-review source-verified the ΔM3/ΔM4 identities, Table 2 MFC rows, Table 3 FICI rows, mechanism evidence, and supplementary packet; publication-grade acceptance is with explicit cautions for figure-interpreted DBAASP antibiofilm endpoint labels.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package/Data_Sheet_1 and linked DBAASP/merged rows were sufficient for worker-4/6 adjudication; no blocking unrecoverable material gap remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains material_extracted_with_gaps at the extraction layer because supplement landing .bin files are HTML landing pages and Data_Sheet_1 has figures, not structured tables; the available XML/PDF/OA/supplement materials are sufficient for the owner-layer gate.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural packet and final files are present; validator-contract readiness is separate from publication-grade review.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP sequence/literature/Table 2/Table 3 rows are source-verified; antibiofilm MBIC/MBIC50 endpoint labels are preserved as source_conflict with source context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity evidence records source-supported Table 2 MFC values, Table 3 FICI rows, Figure 6 biofilm effects, and Figure 9 HDF toxicity statements without inventing missing table values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to directly assayed SEM, membrane permeability, ROS/metacaspase, mitochondria/Ca2+, and phenotypic antibiofilm evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major issue remains after source review; source_conflict rows are explicit cautions and no open rework target remains.

strict_gate.accepted_with_cautions_reason: Preserved nonblocking DBAASP antibiofilm endpoint source_conflicts while all blocking framework-only review gaps were resolved by source review.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP antibiofilm rows assign exact MBIC/MBIC50 concentrations for ΔM3/ΔM4, but the primary paper supplies Figure 6/prose biofilm-response evidence rather than a tabulated MBIC/MBIC50 value; rows remain source_conflict, not source_verified.
OA package Data_Sheet_1.PDF and extracted text contain Supplementary Figure S1/S2 captions/curves but no structured supplementary tables; no extra source table values were fabricated.
